description: This file defines the WebhookTaskConsumer class responsible for processing webhook delivery tasks, fetching event data, building webhook payloads, and sending them to subscribers within a webhooks feature of a larger application.

classes.name: WebhookTaskConsumer
classes.description: A class responsible for consuming webhook tasks, fetching relevant data, constructing payloads, and dispatching webhooks to subscribers.

methods.name: processWebhookTask
methods.description: Main method to process a webhook delivery task, including data fetching, subscriber retrieval, and webhook dispatch.

methods.name: getDataFetcher
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate data fetcher for a given trigger event.

methods.name: sendWebhooksToSubscribers
methods.description: Builds webhook payloads and sends them to each subscriber via the webhook service.

methods.name: buildDTO
methods.description: Constructs a WebhookEventDTO from fetched event data for payload building.
